column1: # Z8, the examples bridge: what upstream's example programs must show against the patched graph.
# Run by scripts/lib/z8_upstream_suite.py examples-run, graded by scripts/lib/z8_expectation_gate.py --check-examples.
# Columns: name <TAB> roles <TAB> observe <TAB> status <TAB> lane <TAB> reason. The grammar of roles and
# observations is in the gate's docstring; `{ep}` is the scenario's endpoint and `{port}` its port.
# Each scenario runs twice, over upstream's own crates (the control) and over the family, and is `same`
# when the family's run shows what the control's does. Every one of the package's 31 programs is in a row.
# No row is measured yet: every row is `unmeasured` and out of the hosted lane until a build host has run
# the bridge once and the row is set to what it measured.
